name: Rexus
source:
A very suspicious man whom Elcia met in the Present. He wields a bamboo sword while giving people glares that could kill puppies, but then again he is probably harmless.

You can get information if you ask him kindly. Don't forget to tease him while you are at it. He can be found in the Present. 

[from [url=http://www.zeiva.net/otome/area_x_cast_rexus.html]official site[/url]]
